study: Greenleaf et al. 2011, Reading Apprenticeship in Biology, AERJ 48(3) (effect sizes from NSF ROLE final report)
delivery_evidence: ~10 days of PD delivered as a summer institute plus day-long sessions during the school year across two summers, with a follow-up summer institute (Appendix A; 'travel, food, and housing for the summer institute'). A moderated list-serve was a minor asynchronous supplement, not the primary channel.
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are California Standards Tests (CST) in Biology, Reading Comprehension, and ELA—broad independent state standardized tests (Table 11).
curriculum_evidence: Reading Apprenticeship is an instructional framework/set of metacognitive routines that teachers integrate into their OWN ongoing biology instruction; not a new student curriculum ('integrate supports for literacy into their own biology instruction'). Teachers got up to $200 for supplementary reading materials, not an adopted curriculum package.
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted effect sizes are the 2006/07 (end of Year 2) wave, the end of the intervention (Table 11; both cross-sectional and longitudinal samples same timepoint).
